name: Magdalena Adamowicz - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on European Union designs (codification)
part_text:
This report does not change any rules. It approves a clean-up of the law on European Union designs, which protect the look of products across the EU. The existing rules are being gathered into one tidy text, with no change in what they actually mean. The only fix is one word in two introductory passages, where "should" goes back to "would" to match the current law. Parliament simply accepts the Commission's proposal.

- **What changes:** The design law is rewritten as one clean text; one word is corrected. Nothing in substance changes.
- **Who it affects:** People and businesses that register or rely on EU-wide design protection.
- **What happens next:** Parliament has set its position; the Council must now agree before the text becomes law.
